## Security & Privacy Checklist
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, credentials, or API keys
- [ ] No unmasked sensitive data in logs or debug output
- [ ] PII detection tested if applicable (no real sensitive data committed)
- [ ] No new dependencies without justification
- [ ] Code follows security guidelines from [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)
- [ ] Verified no data leaks in exports/outputs
- [ ] Input validation added if needed

## Code Quality Checklist
- [ ] Code follows PEP 8 style guidelines (run `black app tests`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`flake8 app tests`)
- [ ] Type hints added where practical (`mypy app`)
- [ ] Docstrings added for functions/classes
- [ ] No breaking changes to public API

## Documentation
- [ ] README updated if needed
- [ ] Docstrings added/updated
- [ ] Code comments added for complex logic
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md updated if process changes
